name: iphone-duo-design-review
title_zh: 折叠 iPhone 五种姿态下，这块屏该怎么排
tagline_zh: 画完 mockup 才发现合上后侧键全被挡住、书折时中缝吃掉半个按钮？它按闭合、展开、书折、桌面。
tagline_en: Your mockup looks fine until it's folded — side buttons buried, the crease eating a button. It critiques your UI.
desc_en: Review or design an iOS interface for iPhone Duo's poses — closed, open, book-folded, tabletop and tent — covering side-mounted controls, asymmetric layouts, fold avoidance, sheets, and how to use the inner display well. Use for design critique, mockup review, or deciding what a screen should look like on a foldable iPhone rather than how to code it.
why_zh: 它不聊代码，只聊姿态：每种折法单独过一遍侧键、非对称布局、避缝和 sheet 落点。
why_en: No code, just poses: each fold gets its own pass on side controls, asymmetric layouts, crease avoidance and sheet placement.
limit_zh: 只做设计与评审，不写一行 SwiftUI；姿态定义来自 iPhone Duo 这一款。
limit_en: Design critique only, no SwiftUI. Poses are iPhone Duo-specific; Galaxy Fold or Pixel Fold hinge orientation and cover ratio won't match.
title_en: How to lay out each screen on a foldable iPhone
